name: Tarocchi Siciliano
description: Tarocchi Siciliano (Sicilian Tarot) is a traditional card game played with a unique 63-card deck. It features ranks and suits distinct from other Tarot decks (Portuguese-style pips). The game is a point-trick game, often played by 4 players. Features the 'Fugitive' (Fool) and 'Miseria' (low trump).

content.text: Tarocchi Siciliano (Sicilian Tarot) is a traditional card game played with a unique 63-card deck. It features ranks and suits distinct from other Tarot decks (Portuguese-style pips). The game is a point-trick game, often played by 4 players. Features the 'Fugitive' (Fool) and 'Miseria' (low trump).
Developed in Sicily; retained Portuguese-style suits after they disappeared elsewhere.
63 cards: 4 suits (King, Queen, Knight, Page, 10-5, Coins has 4) + 21 Trumps + Fugitive.

items.text: Mineo three-player: 20 cards each, 3-card monte; soloist takes monte and discards three. Solo or abandon with mischio/pago/prendo. Vado solo possible after 5 or 20 cards.
Mineo four-player: 15 cards each, 3-card monte. Bidding: pass, chiamo (call a trump for secret partner), or vado solo. Caller names highest trump not held; holder is partner.
Barcellona: Three- or four-player versions; Barcellona four-player uses all 64 cards, 16 each, no monte, fixed or individual play.
Tortorici: Three-player Vanto: chiamo or solo; four-player with fixed partnerships, dealer takes monte.
